title: OpenBMT full capability audit

scope.coverage: Every previously open capability ID appears exactly once; no duplicates or omissions.
scope.lane_assignment: Every audited capability row records its audit_lane; lane counts total 495. Raw scratch lane files were normalized into this artifact.

method: Twelve independent category lanes inspected current product-accessible workflows, source, tests and recorded observations in parallel.
Canonical OpenBMT support and exact vendor benchmark parity were scored separately.
Every positive closure received a second-pass review; one proposed watch-only closure was downgraded to partially supported.

Not implemented means the central current product workflow was absent in inspected evidence. Needs research means the available evidence was insufficient for a responsible support or absence conclusion.

status_definitions.verified_supported: The current product exposes the bounded canonical merchant job and meaningful evidence validates it.
status_definitions.partially_supported: Useful current behavior exists, but the central job or a material boundary is incomplete.
status_definitions.not_implemented: The central current product workflow was absent from the inspected implementation and evidence.
status_definitions.needs_research: The available evidence was insufficient to make a responsible product support determination.
status_definitions.partial_unverified: The canonical OpenBMT job is supported, but exact linked vendor workflow and qualifier parity remains incomplete or unverified.
status_definitions.open_unverified: Exact linked vendor workflow and qualifier parity remains open.

summary.benchmark_parity: All 514 linked benchmark variants remain retained and open; no exact vendor parity claim is made by this audit.
